sample_billing_faq.md::1.text:
What payment methods are accepted?
Acme accepts major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American
Express) for all plans. Business and

sample_billing_faq.md::2.text:
Enterprise plans can also pay via
bank transfer (ACH or wire) or by purchase order, subject to credit
approval.

sample_billing_faq.md::3.text:
What currencies are supported?
Billing is available in USD, EUR, and GBP. The currency shown at
checkout is based on your account's billing address,

sample_billing_faq.md::4.text:
and once a
subscription is created its currency cannot be changed without
cancelling and re-subscribing.

sample_billing_faq.md::5.text:
Do I get an invoice?
Yes. An invoice or receipt is automatically generated for every charge
and available under Account Settings > Billing > Invoice

sample_billing_faq.md::6.text:
History as a
downloadable PDF. Business and Enterprise plans can add a company name,
tax ID, and billing address to appear on invoices.

sample_billing_faq.md::7.text:
What happens if I upgrade mid-cycle?
Upgrading mid-cycle charges a prorated amount immediately, covering the
difference between your old and new

sample_billing_faq.md::8.text:
plan for the remainder of the
current billing period. Your renewal date does not change.

sample_billing_faq.md::9.text:
What happens if I downgrade mid-cycle?
Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle rather
than immediately, and there is no

sample_billing_faq.md::10.text:
prorated credit for the unused
portion of the higher-tier plan in the current cycle.

sample_billing_faq.md::11.text:
What happens if a payment fails?
Acme retries a failed payment automatically over the following 7 days.
During this grace period your plan remains

sample_billing_faq.md::12.text:
active. If payment still
fails after 7 days, the account is downgraded to the free plan (storage
becomes read-only if it exceeds the free plan's

sample_billing_faq.md::13.text:
limit) until a valid
payment method is added and the balance is settled.

sample_billing_faq.md::14.text:
Is billing different for annual vs. monthly plans?
Annual billing is discounted compared to paying monthly (typically
equivalent to two months

sample_billing_faq.md::15.text:
free), charged as a single upfront payment for
the year, and renews automatically at the end of the 12-month period
unless cancelled beforehand.

sample_billing_faq.md::16.text:
How does billing work for Business team seats?
Business plans are billed per seat per month (or per year, if on annual
billing). Adding a seat

sample_billing_faq.md::17.text:
mid-cycle charges a prorated amount for the
remainder of the current period; removing a seat takes effect at the
next renewal and does not issue a

sample_billing_faq.md::18.text:
prorated refund for the current
period, consistent with the mid-cycle downgrade policy above.

sample_billing_faq.md::19.text:
Is tax included in the displayed price?
Displayed prices exclude tax where applicable. VAT, GST, or applicable
sales tax is calculated at checkout

sample_billing_faq.md::20.text:
based on your billing address and
shown as a separate line item before you confirm payment.

sample_billing_faq.md::21.text:
Can Enterprise customers pay by purchase order?
Yes, subject to a credit check and a signed order form. Purchase-order
billing is invoiced according

sample_billing_faq.md::22.text:
to the payment terms in that order form
rather than charged automatically to a card.

sample_billing_faq.md::23.text:
Who can view or change billing information?
Only the account owner and users explicitly granted the "Billing admin"
role can view invoices, change

sample_billing_faq.md::24.text:
the payment method, or modify the
subscription plan; regular team members cannot access billing settings
even if they have workspace admin

sample_product_faq.md::1.text:
How much storage do I get on the free plan?
The free plan includes 5GB of storage and supports files up to 2GB each.
Paid plans start at 100GB on

sample_product_faq.md::2.text:
Pro, 1TB on Business, and unlimited pooled
storage on Enterprise (subject to fair-use review for accounts storing
several hundred terabytes or

sample_product_faq.md::4.text:
Can I share a folder with someone who doesn't have an Acme account?
Yes. Any folder can be shared via a public link. The recipient can view
and

sample_product_faq.md::5.text:
download files without creating an account, but they cannot upload
or edit unless you invite them as a collaborator with an Acme account.
Link

sample_product_faq.md::6.text:
sharing can be restricted to "anyone with the link," "people in
your organization," or specific email addresses, and can be set to
expire

sample_product_faq.md::7.text: automatically after a chosen number of days.

sample_product_faq.md::8.text:
Does Acme support two-factor authentication?
Yes, via an authenticator app (TOTP) or SMS. Two-factor authentication
can be enabled from Account

sample_product_faq.md::9.text:
Settings > Security, and is required by
default for all Business and Enterprise plans. Enterprise admins can
also enforce 2FA org-wide and block SMS

sample_product_faq.md::10.text:
as a fallback method, requiring
an authenticator app only.

sample_product_faq.md::11.text:
What happens to my files if I downgrade from a paid plan?
If your paid plan is storing more data than your new plan's limit, your
account is put

sample_product_faq.md::12.text:
into read-only mode: you can download and delete files,
but you cannot upload new ones, until your usage is back under the new
plan's storage limit.

sample_product_faq.md::13.text:
Files are never deleted automatically because of
a downgrade.

sample_product_faq.md::14.text:
Is there an API?
Yes, a REST API is available on Business and Enterprise plans, documented
at a separate developer portal. The free and Pro plans do

sample_product_faq.md::15.text:
not include
API access. API requests are rate-limited to 1,000 requests per minute
per account on Business, and can be raised on Enterprise by

sample_product_faq.md::17.text:
Is there a desktop sync client?
Yes, available for Windows, macOS, and most major Linux distributions.
The sync client mirrors a chosen local folder

sample_product_faq.md::18.text:
to your Acme storage and
supports selective sync, so you can choose to keep only certain
subfolders available offline on a given device.

sample_product_faq.md::19.text:
Is there a mobile app?
Yes, for iOS and Android. The mobile app supports automatic camera-roll
backup, offline access to files you've pinned, and

sample_product_faq.md::20.text:
can be configured to
only back up over Wi-Fi to avoid mobile data charges.

sample_product_faq.md::21.text:
Does Acme keep file version history?
Yes. Every plan keeps at least 30 days of version history for every
file, so you can restore an earlier version

sample_product_faq.md::22.text:
or recover a file that was
overwritten. Business and Enterprise plans extend this to 180 days, and
Enterprise can request unlimited version history

sample_product_faq.md::24.text:
What happens to deleted files?
Deleted files go to a Trash folder and are recoverable for 30 days on
Free and Pro plans, and 90 days on Business and

sample_product_faq.md::25.text:
Enterprise, after which
they are permanently purged and cannot be recovered by Acme support.

sample_product_faq.md::26.text:
Can I recover a file after Trash has been emptied manually?
No. Emptying Trash manually is immediate and irreversible — Acme does
not retain a

sample_product_faq.md::27.text: further backup copy of manually-purged files.

sample_product_faq.md::28.text:
Are there team or workspace features?
Yes. Business and Enterprise plans include shared team workspaces with
role-based permissions (viewer, editor,

sample_product_faq.md::29.text:
admin), a shared team folder
structure separate from personal storage, and an admin console showing
storage usage and activity per member.

sample_product_faq.md::30.text:
Does Acme support single sign-on (SSO)?
SSO via SAML 2.0 is available on Enterprise plans only, and can be
configured with most major identity

sample_product_faq.md::31.text:
providers. Business and lower plans
support standard email/password or Google/Microsoft account login, but
not SAML-based SSO.

sample_product_faq.md::32.text:
Can I export all of my data if I want to leave Acme?
Yes. Account Settings > Data Export lets you request a full export of
your files and folder

sample_product_faq.md::33.text:
structure as a single downloadable archive. Large
exports (multiple terabytes) may take up to 48 hours to prepare and are
made available via a

sample_product_faq.md::34.text: temporary download link that expires after 7 days.

sample_product_faq.md::35.text:
Does Acme integrate with other tools?
Yes — native integrations exist for several common productivity and
office-suite tools, plus a public API for

sample_product_faq.md::36.text:
building custom integrations
on Business and Enterprise plans. A full list of built-in integrations
is available from the Integrations tab in account

sample_product_faq.md::38.text:
Is there a limit on how much bandwidth I can use?
Free and Pro plans have no hard bandwidth cap under normal usage, but
extremely high sustained

sample_product_faq.md::39.text:
download volumes may be temporarily throttled
to protect service quality for other users. Business and Enterprise
plans are not subject to this

sample_product_faq.md::41.text:
Can I set a custom domain for shared links?
Custom domains for shared links are available on Enterprise plans, so
public links can be served from

sample_product_faq.md::42.text:
your own company domain instead of
Acme's default sharing domain.

sample_refund_policy.md::0.text:
# Acme Cloud Storage — Refund Policy

Acme Cloud Storage offers a 14-day money-back guarantee on all new paid
subscriptions. Refund requests must be

sample_refund_policy.md::1.text:
submitted through the account
billing page within 14 calendar days of the initial charge.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method and

sample_refund_policy.md::2.text:
typically appear
within 5-10 business days, depending on the card issuer or bank.

Digital add-ons purchased separately from the base subscription

sample_refund_policy.md::3.text:
(extra
storage blocks, priority support add-ons) are non-refundable once
provisioned, because the additional capacity is allocated immediately
and

sample_refund_policy.md::4.text:
cannot be reclaimed.

Annual plans downgraded mid-cycle are not eligible for a prorated refund
of the unused period; customers can instead let the

sample_refund_policy.md::5.text:
plan run out and
choose not to renew.

Enterprise contracts follow the refund terms specified in the signed
order form rather than this self-serve

sample_refund_policy.md::6.text:
policy — contact your account
manager for enterprise refund requests.

sample_refund_policy.md::7.text:
Free trials
Plans started via a free trial are not charged until the trial ends, so
there is nothing to refund during the trial period itself. If

sample_refund_policy.md::8.text:
you forget
to cancel and are charged when the trial converts to paid, the standard
14-day money-back guarantee applies from the date of that first

sample_refund_policy.md::10.text:
Chargebacks
Customers are asked to contact Acme support and request a refund
directly rather than filing a chargeback with their card

sample_refund_policy.md::11.text:
issuer.
Accounts with an open chargeback are suspended pending investigation,
and repeated chargebacks (rather than using the refund process)

sample_refund_policy.md::12.text:
may
result in permanent account termination regardless of the outcome of
the chargeback itself.

sample_refund_policy.md::13.text:
Promotional and discounted subscriptions
Subscriptions purchased at a promotional or discounted rate are still
eligible for the standard 14-day

sample_refund_policy.md::14.text:
money-back guarantee, but the refunded
amount is the discounted price actually paid, not the plan's regular
list price.

sample_refund_policy.md::15.text:
Referral credits
Referral credits applied to an account are not cash-equivalent and are
not refunded or paid out if a subscription is refunded or

sample_refund_policy.md::17.text:
window,
only the card-paid portion is returned to the original payment method.

sample_refund_policy.md::18.text:
Multiple refund requests on the same account
An account is limited to one money-back-guarantee refund per rolling
12-month period. A second refund

sample_refund_policy.md::19.text:
request within that window will be
declined even if it otherwise falls within 14 days of a new charge.

sample_refund_policy.md::20.text:
Taxes on refunds
Where sales tax, VAT, or GST was charged on the original purchase, the
tax amount is refunded along with the subscription price.

sample_refund_policy.md::21.text:
Refunds are
processed as a single combined amount rather than separate line items.

sample_refund_policy.md::23.text:
does not, by itself, refund any
already-charged period. Cancelled accounts retain access until the end
of the current paid billing period.

sample_refund_policy.md::24.text:
Checking refund status
Submitted refund requests can be tracked from the billing page under
"Refund history," which shows a status of Pending,

sample_refund_policy.md::25.text:
Approved, or
Declined, along with the date a refund was issued once processed.

sample_refund_policy.md::26.text:
EU and UK statutory withdrawal rights
Customers in the EU and UK may have a statutory 14-day right of
withdrawal for online purchases under local

sample_refund_policy.md::28.text:
during that
period may affect eligibility for statutory withdrawal, consistent with
standard digital-service withdrawal exceptions.

sample_refund_policy.md::29.text:
Refunds after a data deletion request
If you have requested full account and data deletion under Acme's
privacy policy, any refund owed is still

sample_refund_policy.md::30.text:
issued to your original
payment method even though your account data itself will not be
retained; refund processing does not require restoring

sample_security_overview.md::1.text:
Encryption
All files are encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher between your
device and Acme's servers. At rest, files are encrypted using

sample_security_overview.md::2.text:
AES-256,
with encryption keys managed by Acme's key management service. Business
and Enterprise plans can optionally bring their own encryption

sample_security_overview.md::3.text:
key
(BYOK) for an additional layer of control over data-at-rest encryption.

sample_security_overview.md::4.text:
Compliance certifications
Acme maintains SOC 2 Type II certification, renewed annually via an
independent third-party audit, and is ISO 27001

sample_security_overview.md::5.text:
certified for its
information security management system. Acme is also GDPR-compliant
for customers in the EU/UK and offers a Data Processing

sample_security_overview.md::6.text:
Addendum (DPA)
for Business and Enterprise customers on request.

sample_security_overview.md::7.text:
Data residency
By default, customer data is stored in the region closest to account
sign-up (US, EU, or APAC). Business and Enterprise customers can

sample_security_overview.md::8.text:
select
a specific data residency region and Acme will not move that account's
data outside the chosen region without explicit customer request.

sample_security_overview.md::9.text:
Employee access controls
Internal employee access to customer file content is restricted to a
small support engineering team, requires a documented

sample_security_overview.md::10.text:
support ticket
tied to the request, and is logged for audit purposes. Acme employees
cannot browse customer files without such a ticket and

sample_security_overview.md::12.text:
Incident response
Acme maintains a documented incident response process with a target of
notifying affected customers within 72 hours of confirming

sample_security_overview.md::13.text:
a security
incident that affects their data, consistent with common regulatory
notification requirements. Status updates during an active incident

sample_security_overview.md::14.text:
are
posted to Acme's public status page.

sample_security_overview.md::15.text:
Vulnerability disclosure and bug bounty
Acme runs a public vulnerability disclosure program and a paid bug
bounty program for qualifying security

sample_security_overview.md::18.text:
Backups and disaster recovery
Files are replicated across multiple availability zones within a
customer's chosen data residency region. Acme

sample_security_overview.md::19.text:
performs regular disaster
recovery drills and maintains a recovery point objective (RPO) of under
15 minutes and a recovery time objective (RTO) of

sample_security_overview.md::20.text:
under 4 hours for a
full regional failover.

sample_security_overview.md::21.text:
Account security features
Beyond two-factor authentication, Acme provides login alerts for new
device or unrecognized-location sign-ins, an

sample_security_overview.md::22.text:
active-session management
page where you can remotely sign out other devices, and — on Enterprise
plans — IP allowlisting to restrict account access
